summary: Pre-market: the composite risk score holds at 42.44 in a goldilocks regime at the caution level, flat day-over-day (0.08) but down 2.26 on the week. The macro dimension is the lone stretched leg: the ten-year real rate at 2.34 sits at the 96.39th percentile and the ten-year yield at 4.66 at the 96.07th percentile. Overnight Nvidia rose 8.74 percent and Broadcom 4.49 percent on the AI bid, yet the A-share memory chain closed lower despite strong interim earnings (Montage -3.72, ChangXin -0.88, GigaDevice -3.50, Longsys -2.43, Biwin -3.15) — a cross-market divergence on profit-taking. Disinflation is intact (CPI 3.30386, core 2.46652) and liquidity ample (HY OAS 2.67, IG OAS 0.8, reverse repo 0.456), keeping the September-cut path open. The labor crack persists: payrolls -23.0, jobless rate 4.1, participation slipping to 61.4, continuing claims 1778000.

top_risk_drivers.claim: The macro dimension is the only stretched leg (score 59.13). The ten-year real rate at 2.34 sits at the 96.39th percentile and the ten-year yield at 4.66 at the 96.07th percentile, pinning the front end of the curve as the dominant rate anchor.
Liquidity looks ample on the surface but the buffer is thin: reverse repo at 0.456 and HY OAS at 2.67 signal tight conditions, with reverse repo near multi-year lows.
Market breadth is narrow: the new-highs ratio at 0.0645 and semis relative at -9.9201 show leadership concentrated in a few mega-caps while the broad market lags.
Cross-asset confirmation is weak at 0.5, the single largest contribution to the score (7.5), meaning asset-class signals are not yet reinforcing each other into a coherent risk-on move.
The labor crack persists: payrolls at -23.0, the jobless rate at 4.1 but participation slipping to 61.4 and continuing claims at 1778000 — a growth-scare signal under the soft-landing narrative.

supporting_signals.claim: Nvidia rose 8.74 percent and Broadcom 4.49 percent overnight on the AI bid, lifting the semiconductors theme 3.0042 percent and AI software 5.0303 percent.
Software leadership is broad: enterprise software 7.7449 percent, cybersecurity 7.6126 percent and cloud computing 4.2097 percent led the session, widening beyond the chip names.
Volatility is benign: the VIX at 15.21 and realized volatility at 10.5362 keep the volatility dimension at just 18.45, cushioning any drawdown fears.
Disinflation is intact (CPI 3.30386, core 2.46652, PCE 3.34414) and liquidity supportive (Fed balance sheet 6730912, reverse repo 0.456), keeping the cut path open.

contradicting_signals.claim: The composite score at 42.44 stays in caution but the goldilocks regime (low vol, positive momentum, healthy breadth) argues against systemic stress, so the risk is structural, not acute.

The A-share memory chain closed lower (Montage -3.72, ChangXin -0.88, GigaDevice -3.50, Longsys -2.43, Biwin -3.15) despite blockbuster interim profits, diverging from the U.S. semiconductors theme up 3.0042 percent — a profit-taking shakeout, not a regime break.
Crypto risk appetite is rising: Bitcoin at 79340 and Solana at 105.7 pushed higher, a risk-on tell even as breadth stays narrow.

what_changed_today: Risk score held at 42.44 (caution, goldilocks), flat day-over-day at 0.08 and down 2.26 on the week.
Overnight Nvidia +8.74 percent and Broadcom +4.49 percent led a software and chip bid; enterprise software 7.7449 and cybersecurity 7.6126 topped.
A-share memory chain closed lower (Montage -3.72, GigaDevice -3.50, Longsys -2.43, Biwin -3.15) on profit-taking despite strong earnings.
Disinflation prints undershot: CPI 3.30386 vs 3.46353 prior, core 2.46652 vs 2.56579 prior, keeping the cut path open.
Labor mixed: continuing claims eased to 1778000 but participation slipped to 61.4; payrolls -23.0.
watch_next: U.S. employment report early next month (high importance) — the key test of the -23.0 payrolls print and 61.4 participation.
JOLTS job openings and NIO earnings next week — labor demand and China ADR sentiment.
Fed speakers and the cut path: with CPI 3.30386 and core 2.46652 cooling, watch for a dovish shift.
A-share memory chain (Montage -3.72, GigaDevice -3.50) — whether profit-taking spills into U.S. semis after Nvidia +8.74.
Cross-asset confirmation at 0.5 — watch if it rises above 0.5 to confirm a coherent risk-on move.

bull_case.title: Bull case: AI bid extends as real rates roll over
points: Nvidia +8.74 percent and Broadcom +4.49 percent confirm AI demand; software breadth (enterprise 7.7449, cyber 7.6126) widens the rally.
If the ten-year real rate at 2.34 (96.39th percentile) rolls over, the macro dimension decompresses and the score drifts lower.
Disinflation (CPI 3.30386, core 2.46652) plus benign vol (VIX 15.21) keeps the cut path open, favoring risk assets.

base_case.title: Base case: goldilocks holds, narrow and choppy
points: Score holds near 42.44 in caution; goldilocks persists with low vol (VIX 15.21) and positive momentum (semiconductors 3.0042, AI software 5.0303).
Leadership is narrow: new-highs ratio 0.0645 and semis relative -9.9201 flag concentration risk under the soft landing.
Disinflation (CPI 3.30386) and ample liquidity (reverse repo 0.456, HY OAS 2.67) cap downside, but the labor crack (-23.0) caps upside.

bear_case.title: Bear case: macro anchor breaks the soft landing
points: The macro dimension is the constraint: ten-year real rate 2.34 at 96.39th percentile and ten-year yield 4.66 at 96.07th percentile leave little room for error.
If the labor crack deepens (payrolls -23.0, participation 61.4), the growth scare re-prices risk and the new-highs ratio 0.0645 signals fragility.
Semis relative at -9.9201 and memory theme -3.9172 show leadership cracking; a Nvidia reversal from +8.74 would expose the narrow breadth.
